name: A Church Near You
shortDescription: The Church of England’s free church-finding and website platform, with editable church and benefice pages, events, news, contact forms and national-resource links.
company: Archbishops’ Council of the Church of England
suitableContexts: Church of England churches needing a public listing or a low-maintenance main website
Benefices publishing shared and individual church content
Parishes promoting services, events, life-event contact routes and local information

pricing.summary: The Church of England says that A Church Near You is completely free, with no hosting, setup or development charge for its Church of England church and benefice use case. A parish remains responsible for any separately purchased domain name or external services it links to.

gdprInformation: The published site privacy notice identifies the Archbishops’ Council as operator and gives a UK ICO registration number. It describes account, contact, technical and usage data, including potential special-category data received through direct interaction. This is service-level information, not a substitute for a PCC deciding what personal data it should publish or collect through a particular page or form.
coreFeatures: Optional Church Organiser links for room bookings and life events
integrations: The Church Organiser life-event contact forms
Optional redirects from a separately owned domain
importExport: Confirm available export, backup and migration options for page content, images, contacts, events and form submissions before making it the sole public-web record
support: Church of England training guides, videos, webinars and a support team are advertised
Editor access is requested through the church or benefice page and approved through the service workflow

operator.value: Published terms identify the Archbishops’ Council as the operator of A Church Near You and give its Church House, London address, charity number and ICO registration.

scope-and-pricing.value: The Church of England describes the service as a free main-website option for Church of England churches, with no hosting, setup or development costs.

website-features.value: The Church of England lists editable pages, events, news, contact forms, video embeds, benefice support, resources and optional integrations with The Church Organiser.

privacy.value: Published privacy information identifies the Archbishops’ Council, explains categories of data processed and provides data-subject rights information.

editorial.assessment: A Church Near You is a Church of England website and discovery service, not a general church database. It is a no-cost option for a parish that needs an editable public presence without commissioning a separate site. It will not suit every UK church or every need for branding, design, content downloads or connections to other systems.
bestFor: Church of England parishes that need a free public website or an improved church listing
Benefices maintaining shared and individual church information
Small churches that need events, service information and contact routes without managing web hosting
strengths: Clearly identified UK Church of England operator
No stated hosting, setup or development cost within the intended scope
Public church discovery combined with editable website content
Documented benefice, events and Church Organiser workflows
limitations: Intended for Church of England churches rather than all UK denominations
Not a people database, giving system, safeguarding record, accounting package or full church-management suite
Published privacy information should be read alongside the parish’s own decisions about page content, forms and sensitive information
Confirm content export, domain, branding, accessibility and integration requirements before retiring an existing website

procurementVerdict.problem: Creating and maintaining a clear public church presence without a separate hosting or development budget
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A national Church of England discovery service that can also become an editable church or benefice website
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Create a test content plan for a real church page, then assess editor permissions, event and contact-form workflow, public accessibility, domain forwarding and the ability to retrieve content if the parish later changes platform
